reserveReview.rationale: Midas identifies mGLOBAL as exposure to Fasanara receivables and asset-based finance. On September 14 the latest visible aggregate proof-of-reserve report was dated July 13; current product TVL and operational wallets do not refresh that report or disclose a current loan tape. The reserve remains one unresolved private-credit strategy envelope. Redemption-liquidity targets are policy disclosures, not measured reserve-line weights.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current loan-level weights, obligor and originator concentrations, warehouse facilities and actual cash-versus-receivables allocation remain unverified. custodyProfile.uncertainty: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28 of the Midas Aave Horizon post reconfirms issuance through a dedicated compartment of a bankruptcy-remote Luxembourg Securitisation Vehicle and monthly independent valuation by JTC Luxembourg (supports segregated assets and structured bankruptcy-remoteness). It still does not name the custodian(s) safekeeping underlying receivables or cash accounts, does not publish provider shares, and discloses no rehypothecation terms; zero fund-level leverage is not a reuse prohibition. Fordefi remains a platform-level on-chain custody technology claim from Midas transparency listings rather than a mGLOBAL-specific custody document. The compartment is an exempt Luxembourg securitisation undertaking, not a prudentially supervised fund.
